capabilities: Synchronize tasks back and forth with a Vikunja instance
Add, update, delete, and complete tasks from either side
Sync labels, due dates, done dates, and priorities
Run sync manually or automatically on a set interval
extras: Unofficial plugin; single-user only — conflicts always resolve in favor of Obsidian, and the README warns against team use. Known sync-from-Vikunja issues are tracked in issue #13; several features (priority, descriptions, relations, projects) are marked under development.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep tasks in notes synchronized with an external task manager like Vikunja.

relations.evidence: This unofficial plugin connects Obsidian and Vikunja.
The experience with this plugin is a lot like the excellent plugins for todoist
